# Schwed Kids Dental

> > Schwed Kids Dental is a comprehensive pediatric dentistry practice in Garland, TX, offering specialized services including sedation dentistry, laser dentistry, orthodontics, and oral surgery for children of all needs.

Schwed Kids Dental, led by Dr. Matt Schwed, serves families throughout the Dallas-Fort Worth area with advanced pediatric dental care. The practice specializes in anxiety-friendly treatments using cutting-edge technology like Solea® laser dentistry and offers comprehensive services from preventive care to complex oral surgery.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric Dentistry
- Sedation Dentistry
- Laser Dentistry (Solea®)
- Dr. Matt Schwed
- Pediatric Orthodontics
- Frenectomy (Tongue-tie/Lip-tie)
- Restorative Dentistry
- Dental Anxiety Management
- Special Needs Dentistry
- Myofunctional Therapy
- Oral Surgery
- Clear Aligners (Candid)
- Garland, TX
- Child-Friendly Dental Care
- Nitrous Oxide Sedation

## Core Services

- [Pediatric Dentistry Services](https://schwedkidsdental.com/what-we-do): Overview of comprehensive pediatric dental services offered
- [Restorative Dentistry](https://schwedkidsdental.com/what-we-do/restorative-dentistry): Restorative dentistry services: fillings, crowns, cavity treatment
- [Sedation Dentistry](https://schwedkidsdental.com/what-we-do/sedation-dentistry): Sedation options for anxious children: nitrous oxide, oral sedation
- [Laser Dentistry](https://schwedkidsdental.com/what-we-do/laser-dentistry): Advanced Solea laser dentistry for painless, precise treatments
- [Pediatric Oral Surgery](https://schwedkidsdental.com/what-we-do/pediatric-oral-surgery): Oral surgery services: extractions, tongue-tie release, space maintainers

## Specialized Treatments

- [Lip and Tongue-Tie Treatment](https://schwedkidsdental.com/what-we-do/lip-and-tongue-tie): Laser frenectomy for tongue-ties and lip-ties in infants/children
- [Pediatric Orthodontics](https://schwedkidsdental.com/what-we-do/pediatric-orthodontics): Orthodontic services including clear aligners (Candid)
- [Myofunctional Therapy](https://schwedkidsdental.com/what-we-do/myofunctional-therapy): Myofunctional therapy for tongue thrust, sleep apnea, jaw alignment
- [Special Needs Dentistry](https://schwedkidsdental.com/what-we-do/special-needs-dentistry): Specialized dental care for children with special needs
